properties.summary: Incident Type: PLATFORM - NRC Report ID: 949678 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 949678
Incident Time: 2010-08-02 16:00:00
Nearest City: Mobile, AL
Incident Type: PLATFORM
Material: CONDENSATE
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 40 feet by 0.5 miles (area 2.42 acres)
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 2.59 gallons
WHILE MAKING SAFETY OBSERVATION ROUNDS THIS MORNING THE PLATFORM, OPERATORS OBSERVED A WHITE FOAMY FLOCK AND LIGHT SHEEN COMING FROM THE OVERBOARD WATER - SKIMMER LINE. UPON CLOSER REVIEW IT WAS DETERMINED THAT THE SHEEN WAS INDEED ORIGINATING FROM THE SKIMMER OVERBOARD WATER LINE. AT THAT TIME, 11:00AM THE PLATFORM WAS SHUT IN, WHICH EFFECTIVELY ENDED ALL WELLS PRODUCTION PROCESS INTO THE PROCESS SYSTEM, OVERBOARD WATER PROCESSING SKIMMER. THE SKIMMER WAS BATCH TREATED WITH A DEMULSIFIER - CLARIFIER KNOWN AS "PHASETREAT 6212", WHICH EFFECTIVELY BROKE DOWN FLOCK AND SHEEN AGENTS IN THE WATER. THE OVERBOARD DISCHARGE WAS RESTARTED WITH NO SAMPLES SHOWING ANY HYDROCARBON SHEEN PRODUCING MATERIAL PRESENT. THE PLATFORM WELLS PRODUCTION PROCESS WAS RESTARTED @12:30 PM AND PRODUCTION WAS BROUGHT UP TO NORMAL RATE WITH NO FLOCK OR SHEEN OBSERVED. A VISUAL SHEEN WATCH IS ONGOING AT THIS TIME AND AN OVERBOARD WATER SAMPLE IS BEING TAKEN HOURLY TO ENSURE THAT THE SHEEN HAS EFFECTIVELY BEEN CORRECTED.
